name: Winton Land Limited
summary: Winton Land Limited engages in the real estate business in New Zealand and Australia. The company operates through Residential Development, Retirement Villages, and Commercial Portfolio segments. The Residential Development segment designs, develops, markets, and sells residential properties, such as land lots, dwellings, townhouses, and apartments. The Retirement Villages segment develop and operate retirement villages. The Commercial Portfolio segment engages in leasing of real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Auckland, New Zealand.
